thesis: Ben Horowitz argues that culture is defined by actions rather than beliefs and that individual leaders can alter historical outcomes, citing how Kip Hickman's implementation of SSL at Netscape secured the open internet against proprietary alternatives. He further illustrates this point by noting that the smartphone ecosystem now pays a 30% tax to Apple because no one else stepped up to secure the open platform at that critical moment.
